definition: to reach a place you were heading for
description: A young woman climber in a red down jacket with the hood up, ski goggles, black trousers, a harness with an ice axe and yellow boots with crampons steps onto the narrow snowy summit of a mountain on a clear day, her arms spread for balance. Far below lies a sea of white clouds with rocky peaks poking through. She stands still on the top, lifts her goggles onto her head, laughs and waves. A rope runs down behind her and her shadow falls across the snow.
